'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Fall of the Assad regime]]
***[[Deir ez-Zor offensive (2024)|Deir ez-Zor offensive]], [[Eastern Syria insurgency]]
****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iraq)|Iraqi foreign minister]] [[Fuad Hussein]] warns that [[Islamic State|ISIS]] cells in [[Syria]] have begun reorganizing and taking new land following the collapse of the [[Syrian Armed Forces]] and subsequent abandonment of weapons depots. [https://asharq.com/sub-live/politics/34682/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%B4-%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B9-%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%87-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A3%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%82%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A/ (''Asharq News'')]
***The [[Baniyas Refinery]], Syria's largest [[oil refinery]], stops operating after ceasing to receive the [[crude oil]] from [[Iran]] that previously made up the majority of the country's input. [https://www.ft.com/content/9d65fb40-a389-42ad-b9c5-42533a276dde (''Financial Times'')]
**[[Operation Dawn of Freedom]], [[Turkish involvement in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[2024 Kobani clashes]]
****The [[U.S.]]-backed [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] vow to fight [[Turkey]] and pro-Turkish [[Syrian National Army|rebel groups]] in [[Kobani]], [[Aleppo Governorate]], Syria. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-backed-syrian-democratic-forces-say-they-will-fight-turkey-allied-groups-2024-12-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[Ahmed al-Sharaa]], the [[emir]] of [[Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham]], makes an announcement claiming that the country is exhausted by [[perpetual war]]fare and is no longer a threat to [[Middle East|its neighbors]] or the [[Western world]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c05p9g2nqmeo (BBC News)]
***The [[Military Operations Command]] forces take control of several towns in [[Raqqah Governorate]], Syria. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/351837/ (SOHR)]
***[[Iraq]] announces the repatriation of members of the [[Syrian Armed Forces]] who fled after the [[fall of the Assad regime]] through the [[Al-Qa'im border crossing]], back to Syria. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/19/iraq-starts-to-send-syrian-soldiers-back-home (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Russian intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Satellite imagery]] reveals that [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] are mobilizing heavy planes at [[Khmeimim Air Base]] in [[Latakia Governorate]] and are also mobilizing ships at [[Tartus naval base]], indicating a potential [[Withdrawal (military)|withdrawal]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2ev2prep2o (BBC News)] 
***[[Abdul Hamid Dbeibah]], the [[Prime Minister of Libya|Prime Minister]] of the [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]-based [[Government of National Unity (Libya)|Government of National Unity]] of [[Libya]], denounces the entry of [[Russia]]n forces from Syria into the eastern part of Libya. [https://libyaobserver.ly/news/pm-dbeibah-rejects-entry-russian-forces-libya-coming-syria (''The Libya Observer'')]
***[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says that [[Russia]] helped evacuate 4,000 [[Iran]]ian fighters from Syria. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/putin-says-russia-evacuated-4-000-iranian-fighters-from-syria/3428955 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[Prosecution of Syrian civil war criminals]]
***The [[Syrian Interim Government]] announces that they have begun preparing lists of people from the [[Ba'athist Syria|former regime]] who were involved in [[War crimes in the Syrian civil war|war crimes]], torture, and murder. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-834146 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[December 2024 Israeli airstrikes in Yemen]]
***[[Israel]] carries out a series of [[airstrike]]s against the [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] in western [[Yemen]], damaging the [[Marib–Ras Isa oil pipeline|Ras Isa oil facility]], the port of [[as-Salif]] and several [[power station]]s in [[Sanaa]], and killing at least nine people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/israel-carries-out-air-strikes-on-yemen (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury]] announces sanctions on the governor of the [[Central Bank of Yemen]] in [[Sanaa]], Yemen, and several Houthi officials and associated companies and vessels, accusing them of trafficking [[dual-use technology|dual-use]] weapon components and [[Iran]]ian [[petroleum]] to the Houthis. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/us-imposes-more-sanctions-on-yemens-houthis-amid-escalation-with-israel (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.jns.org/us-announces-sanctions-on-19-people-entities-for-supporting-iran-houthis/ (JNS)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza genocide]], [[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Human Rights Watch]] accuses [[Israel]] of committing "acts of [[genocide]]" in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] by damaging [[water supply network|water supply infrastructure]] and depriving civilians of [[water resources|clean water]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/israel-accused-of-acts-of-genocide-over-gaza-water-access/a-71106235 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/human-rights-watch-says-israels-deprivation-water-gaza-is-act-genocide-2024-12-19/ (Reuters)] [https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/19/israels-crime-extermination-acts-genocide-gaza (Human Rights Watch)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian  War|Military aids during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[United Kingdom and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Secretary of State for Defence|British defence secretary]] [[John Healey]] announces a proposal to send [[British Armed Forces|military advisors]] to train [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c878ypxgl3qo (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Parliament of Abkhazia shooting]]
**A [[Legislator|lawmaker]] is killed and another is injured in a shooting inside the [[People's Assembly of Abkhazia|Parliament]] in [[Sukhumi]], [[Abkhazia]]. The perpetrator, identified as MP and former Sukhumi mayor [[Adgur Kharazia]], flees the scene. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/lawmaker-shot-dead-in-parliament-in-breakaway-georgian-region-of-abkhazia (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Two [[Mexican Army|soldiers]] are killed after an explosion caused by an [[improvised explosive device|improvised landmine]] at a [[Clandestine chemistry|drug laboratory]] in [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]]. Three days earlier, two other soldiers were killed and three more injured during a similar incident in Michoacán. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-explosives-soldiers-killed-ieds-bomb-michoacan-de63fe119d1d0f32154b1b47b9113a01 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**The death toll from [[Cyclone Chido]] in [[Mozambique]] increase to 73, including 66 in [[Cabo Delgado Province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/19/cyclone-chido-death-toll-in-mozambique-rises-to-73 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**A vessel carrying approximately 80 migrants heading for [[Spain]] sinks in [[Morocco|Moroccan]] waters, leaving 70 people missing and eleven survivors rescued. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/12/26/morocco-migrant-boat-wreck-on-dec-19-left-70-missing-mali_6736472_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
*{{ill|Fire at the Central Warehouse|zh|全聯臺中倉儲火災}}
**Nine people are killed during a fire at a [[PX Mart]] [[warehouse]] building under construction in [[Taichung]], [[Taiwan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/taiwan-taichung-fire-px-mart-supermarket-foam-bd06e5c2992a6a048ad8203749e945eb (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–India relations]]
**[[Sino-Indian border dispute]]
***[[National Security Advisor (India)|Indian national security advisor]] [[Ajit Doval]] and [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (China)|Chinese foreign minister]] [[Wang Yi (politician)|Wang Yi]] meet in [[Beijing]], [[China]], and reach a six-point consensus to maintain peace along the border, refine border management rules, resume cross-border exchanges, and work toward resolving border disputes. A follow-up meeting is planned to be held in [[India]] next year. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/12/18/asia/china-india-resume-border-talks-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Georgia–United Kingdom relations]], [[Georgia–United States relations]], [[2024 Georgian post-election protests]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] and the United States impose sanctions on [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]n officials, including [[Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia|Interior Minister]] [[Vakhtang Gomelauri]], in response to alleged violent crackdowns on [[Pro-Europeanism|pro-European]] protests. [https://efe.com/en/latest-news/2024-12-19/us-uk-sanction-georgian-minister-of-internal-affairs-over-crackdown-on-protests/ (EFE)]
*[[Hungary–Poland relations]]
**[[Hungary]] grants [[political asylum]] to former [[Poland|Polish]] deputy [[Ministry of Justice (Poland)|justice minister]] [[:pl:Marcin Romanowski|Marcin Romanowski]], who faces allegations of [[corruption in Poland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/hungary-grants-asylum-former-polish-deputy-minister-romanowski-says-orbans-chief-2024-12-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[France]]'s [[Directorate-General for External Security]] reports that four French nationals detained in [[Burkina Faso]] on allegations of being foreign [[Espionage|intelligence agents]] have been released following mediation by [[Morocco]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/burkina-faso-releases-french-nationals-after-detaining-year-116937449 (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Northeastern United States drone sightings]]
**The [[U.S.]] [[Federal Aviation Administration]] bans the flying of drones over multiple cities in [[New Jersey]] citing "special security reasons". [https://6abc.com/post/drones-restrictions-effect-amid-ongoing-sightings-new-jersey/15675675/ (WPVI-TV)]
*[[Deportation and removal from the United States]]
**The [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] agency reports 271,484 [[deportation]]s in the past [[fiscal year]], the most since 2014 and almost double of the previous fiscal year. [https://apnews.com/article/immigration-deportations-trump-mexico-ice-e09b2f8b9eb5e91ebc8f143748f0021a (AP)] [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/ice-deportations-catch-up-trump-era-numbers-fy-2024-biden-admin-comes-close (FOX News)]
*[[Mazan rapes]]
**The [[French judiciary courts|Judicial Court]] in [[Avignon]], [[France]], finds Dominique Pelicot guilty of the aggravated [[rape]] of his ex-wife [[Gisèle Pelicot]], and imposes the maximum sentence of 20 years in prison. The 50 other defendants in the case are also convicted of crimes ranging from attempted rape to aggravated rape, and receive prison sentences ranging from three to 15 years. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/verdict-due-gisele-pelicot-rape-case-that-horrified-world-2024-12-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Italians|Italian]] journalist [[Cecilia Sala]] is [[List of foreign nationals detained in Iran|detained]] by [[Iran]]ian authorities in [[Tehran]] and held at [[Evin Prison]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italian-journalist-cecilia-sala-detained-iran-fb8e6a9adb9ca3b5adf3943b5d146ca1 (AP)]
*A [[High court (Malaysia)|Malaysian high court]] acquits [[Rosmah Mansor]], the wife of former [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|prime minister]] [[Najib Razak]], of 17 charges of [[money laundering]] and [[tax evasion]] due to [[Burden of proof (law)|insufficient evidence]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysian-court-acquits-wife-ex-pm-najib-money-laundering-tax-evasion-2024-12-19/ (Reuters)]
